scope: Precise new same-A consumer interface; unchanged canonical definitions reused with pinned hash checks

actual_Gaussian.definition: multivariateGaussian μ S maps stdGaussian(EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) through x ↦ μ + toEuclideanCLM(CFC.sqrt S)x.
actual_Gaussian.fallback: Documentation and actual existing fallback lemma state non-PSD S makes CFC.sqrt S=0 and gives Dirac μ. Thus writing a generic Gaussian constructor or IsGaussian alone would not identify the desired covariance.
actual_Gaussian.actual_branch: Exact consumer chooses μ=0 and S=A⁻¹. Existing actual_precision_admissible returns PosDef of precisely this literal A; the unchanged canonical GPD leaf internally derives inverse precision positivity. This excludes the fallback without adding any public hPD/covariance premise.
actual_Gaussian.evidence: Direct constructor/documentation window plus reused unchanged critical review for inverse positivity/CFC semantics.

canonical_GPD.interface: For real finite A and hA:A.PosDef, actual multivariateGaussian 0 A⁻¹ equals volume.withDensity(ENNReal.ofReal(sqrt(A.det)/(2π)^((n:ℝ)/2)*exp(-xᵀAx/2))).
canonical_GPD.same_carrier: EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), exact coordinate function WithLp.ofLp x, same real dot product and Matrix.mulVec. This is actual finite-coordinate xᵀAx, not an abstract covariance witness or arbitrary target law.
canonical_GPD.reference_measure: Explicit (volume : Measure(EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) is Euclidean Lebesgue volume, as in unchanged accepted definition review; it is not a Gaussian probability or sphere measure. The type printer uses ℙ notation, but the typed source reference is volume. This is separate from Haar probability on O(d).
canonical_GPD.scope: Existing canonical density lemma is reused unchanged; it is not new determinant-source credit.

same_A_admissibility.interface: actual_precision_admissible hd hκ O returns A.PosDef ∧ PSD(A−I) ∧ PSD(κI−A) for literal midpoint-grid diagonal conjugation.
same_A_admissibility.match: Its inline diagonalValue expression expands to the new consumer let diagonalValue; θ and O are syntactically the same formulas. Selecting its first component supplies PosDef of the same actual A internally.
same_A_admissibility.public_inputs: Only d,hd,κ,hκ and arbitrary full orthogonal O. No hPD is added to new consumer.

new_determinant_output.required: New actual_precision_det must supply A.det = ∏ i:Fin d, diagonalValue i for the same θ/diagonalValue/A.
new_determinant_output.consumer_role: Replace the canonical GPD coefficient sqrt(A.det) by sqrt of the explicit product. Determinant/product equality is a consumed output, not an input or a duplicate wrapper theorem.
new_determinant_output.actual_use_not_yet_verified: The future Test proof term must contain the new producer as an actual dependency. A type-only proposition or unused textual mention is insufficient.

coefficient_and_orientation: Only the product-based density prefactor is O-independent. The actual target covariance A⁻¹ and quadratic exponent involving the same A retain hidden orientation. No law invariance claim is present.
real_exponent: (d:ℝ)/2 is real division and exponentiation, including odd d. No Nat division or dropped half-grid occurs. Source 1/2 factor in exponent is preserved.
